descriptionHtml:
思路 / Approach · TC-12 Important Points · S15 「导入之前的记录（粘贴或拍照，两个模式）不会建 Important Points」 Importing a prior note (paste or photo, both modes) does not create Important Points

覆盖的 UAT 步骤 / 票 AC：

  • U1 The panel is physician-authored only (PR #49): nothing is generated from the pre-round note, and saving a pre-round note on a patient with no points leaves the Important Points panel empty. …（UAT TC-12；TFA-92590 AC 2；TFA-92590 description） — gate: blocked: TFA-92590 in progress
  • U7 Every step is repeated in Nursing Home and must pass in both modes.（UAT TC-12；UAT 3.3；TFA-92590 AC 3） — gate: blocked: TFA-92590 in progress

测试设计方法：错误推测（error-guessing） — 专门去撞最容易出错的地方（失败、重复点、两个标签页、时钟不对、注入的指令）。

Given Hospital patient and Nursing Home resident, each with one physician-entered point

When Hospital: Previous Notes > Paste, paste a prior note that lists key issues, Save & Extract (live model), open the pre-round editor. Nursing Home: the same with a Nursing Home prior note that has 'Key issues:'. Hospital photo: Previous Notes > photo of the same prior note (fixture image upload), Save & Extract

Then Important Points still holds only the physician's own point in each chart after each import

通过的标准（oracle，节选）：backendChecks, each point's source included: Hospital importantPoints == [{text: 'QA own point: ask about orthopnea', source: 'manual'}] after the paste and again after the photo; Nursing Home texts == ['QA own NH point: ask about dentures']; no point with source 'prior-note' (UAT 'physician-authored only', ticket 'the app never creates points'). …

在哪跑：dev；测试方法 AGENT · 浏览器 agent；矩阵里排的车道 浏览器 agent（blocked）

S15 是我们自己编的用例号（覆盖矩阵 cases/TC-12.matrix.json 里的编号），不是 UAT 文档里的步骤号。

环境：dev — dev 部署，build e02167f（Deploy Convex，2026-10-12T18:24:27Z）；账号和地址不写进报告；run folder runs/2026-10-14-dev。

测试方法：AGENT · 浏览器 agent；辅助：API · 接口（Convex 函数） — 按 cases/test-methods.json 的分类，分类说在 both 跑；来源：dev。
